findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed during today’s inspection.
1. The stainless steel sheet sealing the edge of the wall behind the hand sink by the drinks station.
2. The tiles placement around the drainage system between the dish area and the cook line were observed broken.
3. caulking on the multi-compartment sink in the produce prep area was observed coming off.
4. The caulking sealing the countertop right of the dish machine was observed coming off the wall.
5. The stainless steel sheets in the utility sink were observed unscrewed and coming off the wall including the caulking.

PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that these areas are sealed appropriately providing smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.
